name: Indiana YMCA Youth and Government (INYaG)
org: Indiana YMCA Youth and Government (Alliance of Indiana YMCAs)
city: Indianapolis, IN (state conference), delegations across Indiana
what_you_do: Learn how government works by acting it out. Delegates research and debate public issues. They take mock legislative, executive and court roles. Then they serve as delegates at the state conference.
pay_detail: Program fees are not listed on the page read. Ask the program contact.
duration: School year, ending with a state conference
deadline_text: 2026-27 conference and registration dates are not posted on the page read (it links only a 2024-2025 calendar).
how_to_apply: Contact Shelby Lashbrook. Use shelby@indianaymcas.org or (317) 715-2145. Do this to join, start a delegation, volunteer or sponsor.
notes: Not a job. Office: 6610 N Shadeland Ave, Indianapolis, IN 46220, open Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 4:30 pm.
